author: Ari Koslow
title: Tobias Harris unlikely to return to Pistons
desc: Tobias Harris is reportedly unlikely to return to Detroit in free agency.
impact: Harris should draw plenty of interest from other teams in free agency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Joshua Jefferson to miss start of Summer League
desc: Joshua Jefferson will miss the start of the Summer League in Sacramento.
impact: Jefferson cannot play for the Nets' Summer League team until the Julius Randle trade is finalized. He is expected to be good to go for the second part in Las Vegas.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyler Bilodeau good to go for Summer League
desc: Tyler Bilodeau is expected to be available for both Summer League stops.
impact: Bilodeau was a second-round pick of the Nets this year. He will figure to compete for a depth role in their back court.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mikel Brown Jr. good to go for Summer League
desc: Mikel Brown Jr. is expected to be available for both Summer League stops.
impact: Brown was the No. 6 overall pick by Brooklyn this year. He should step into an immediate major role in the Nets back court.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Peyton Watson linked to Clippers
desc: Peyton Watson reportedly continues to be described as a "likely target" for the Clippers.
impact: Watson is a restricted free agent this offseason. He'll figure to draw interest from other teams.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Walker Kessler to meet with three teams Tuesday
desc: Walker Kessler is scheduled to meet with three teams on Tuesday.
impact: The Lakers are rumored to be one of the three teams. Kessler is a restricted free agent this offseason.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Russell Westbrook III linked to Wizards
desc: The Wizards reportedly have interest in Russell Westbrook III.
impact: Westbrook previously played one year in Washington back in the 2020-21 season. He would figure to step into a reserve role.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jonathan Kuminga to draw interest from Bulls, Cavs
desc: The Bulls and Cavaliers are expected to be among the teams to express interest in Jonathan Kuminga in free agency.
impact: Kuminga was also previously linked to the Kings. He should draw plenty of interest after having his team option declined by the Hawks.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jrue Holiday expected to remain in Portland
desc: The Trail Blazers are not expected to look to trade Jrue Holiday.
impact: After trading for Ja Morant on Monday, it would make sense that Portland could look to move another guard. It appears the veteran will remain with the team, at least for now.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Sandro Mamukelashvili linked to Lakers
desc: The Lakers have been linked to Sandro Mamukelashvili.
impact: Mamukelashvili declined his player option with the Raptors. The Lakers will figure to be looking to add size in free agency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jamir Watkins expected to work towards multi-year deal with Wizards
desc: The Washington Wizards and Jamir Watkins are expected to work on a new multi-year contract.
impact: The Wizards declined the $2.15 million team option for Watkins. He'll figure to return on a new deal.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luke Kennard expected to draw interest from Suns
desc: Luke Kennard is expected to draw interest from the Phoenix Suns when free agency opens on Tuesday.
impact: Kennard is expected to be among the veteran guards on Phoenix's radar in free agency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Donovan Clingan not expected to be traded
desc: The Trail Blazers are not expected to trade Donovan Clingan.
impact: Portland made a notable trade for Ja Morant on Monday. Both him and Damian Lillard will look to connect with Clingan at the rim next season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ariel Hukporti to become unrestricted free agent
desc: The New York Knicks are not extending a qualifying offer to center Ariel Hukporti.
impact: Hukporti will become an unrestricted free agent. He'll figure to seek a depth role on another team.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nolan Traore (knee) will not play in Summer League
desc: Nolan Traore had a "scope" on his knee so won't play in either Summer League.
impact: Traore was one of the Nets first-round picks last year. He averaged just under nine points across 56 games played (31 starts) as a rookie.
